query: PRAGMA table_info / schema listing for all eight tables (badges, comments, postHistory, postLinks, posts, tags, users, votes)

query: group posts by post type code with counts, and inspect title/body samples per code
result: 1 question 42912; 2 answer 47755; 3 orphaned tag wiki 6; 4 tag wiki excerpt 639; 5 tag wiki 640; 6 moderator nomination 9; 7 wiki/help page 5. Codes 4 and 5 hold tag documentation text; code 2 rows carry a parent reference while code 1 rows do not.

query: group votes by vote type code with counts
group postHistory by event type code with counts and inspect stored text samples for codes 4 and 5
group postLinks by link type code with counts
result: type 1 plain link: 10186 rows; type 3 duplicate marking: 916 rows; both post references populated on all 11102 rows

query: select tags values from posts, and compare tag names in the tag table with their usage
result: post tag values are concatenations of bracketed names, e.g. a three-tag post stores '<bayesian><prior><elicitation>'; the tag table stores the bare name 'bayesian'. Stored usage counter for bayesian is 1342 and the bracketed-name match yields 1342 posts; humorous tag stores 4 and matches 4 posts; distributions stores 1880 against 1879 observed.
validation_method: value sampling and cross-check against the stored usage counter

query: count tag names that themselves contain a leading bracket character
result: 0 of 1032 tag names contain bracket characters

query: select the tag row whose name is bayesian
result: tag bayesian has Id 1, usage counter 1342, excerpt reference 20258 and wiki reference 20257

query: select the tag row whose name is humor, and list posts whose tag value carries it
result: tag humor has Id 204, usage counter 4, and no excerpt or wiki reference. Four question posts carry humorous tagging, with view counts 288, 64481, 66972 and 1204; one of them additionally carries a second topic tag.

query: resolve the excerpt and wiki references of selected tags to the posts they point at
result: for tag bayesian the excerpt reference resolves to post 20258 and the wiki reference to post 20257; those posts are tag documentation content (wiki excerpt and wiki respectively), not questions or answers.
validation_method: join-based resolution and post type inspection

query: count tags with no excerpt reference
